description: One qa lens's verdict on a task in a round; the `task:verdicts` entry's fields. Every verdict is kept.

task.description: The task key the lens judged.
task.title: Task

lens.description: The lens that judged it, such as `security`, `ux`, `ui` or `code`.
lens.title: Lens

round.description: The qa round the verdict belongs to, counted from 1.
round.title: Round

outcome.description: `PASS` accepts the task; `CHANGES` asks for another round.
outcome.title: Outcome

reason.description: Why the lens gave it; empty when none was given.
reason.title: Reason

time.description: When the verdict was given, in epoch seconds.
time.title: Time

source.description: The producer that posted it through the CloudEvents ingest.
source.title: Source

title: VerdictEvent
